_comment: Per-project configuration. Copy to your repo root and fill in.

sentinel_paths._comment: Touching any of these in a diff makes Engine 2 mandatory. These are the places where 'what needs what' is declared: stage definitions, artifact requirements, routes, required fields.

fanout._comment: second_echelon_trigger: findings from distinct reviewers pointing at one subsystem before reinforcing it

engine_2._comment: strength 2 = pairwise. Escalate to 3 for dimensions where pairwise found a dead end.
